[package]
name = "tika-indra-ocr-client"
edition = "2024"
version = "0.0.1"
description = "A bounded Tika 3.3.2 Tesseract CLI adapter for a persistent Indra OCR service"
license = "Apache-2.0"
rust-version = "1.99"
publish = false

[workspace]
members = [".", "shared/trace-context"]
exclude = ["runtime", "evaluation"]
resolver = "3"

[dependencies.indra-trace-context]
path = "shared/trace-context"

[dev-dependencies]
stats_alloc = "=0.1.10"

[dev-dependencies.criterion]
version = "=0.8.2"
features = ["cargo_bench_support"]
default-features = false

[[bin]]
path = "src/main.rs"
name = "indra-tesseract"
edition = "2024"
required-features = []

[[bench]]
path = "benches/streaming.rs"
name = "streaming"
harness = false
edition = "2024"
required-features = []

[[test]]
path = "tests/streaming_allocations.rs"
name = "streaming_allocations"
harness = false
edition = "2024"
required-features = []

[[test]]
path = "tests/trace_wire.rs"
name = "trace_wire"
edition = "2024"
required-features = []

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"
name = "tika_indra_ocr_client"
edition = "2024"
required-features = []
crate-type = ["lib"]

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"
incremental = false
overflow-checks = true
strip = true

[profile.release.package]

[profile.maxperf]
inherits = "release"
lto = "fat"

[profile.maxperf.package]

[profile.profiling]
debug = 1
inherits = "release"
strip = false

[profile.profiling.package]

[package]
name = "indra-trace-context"
edition = "2024"
version = "0.0.1"
workspace = "../.."
description = "Bounded W3C version-00 context shared by the OCR bridge and telemetry"
license = "Apache-2.0"
rust-version = "1.99"
publish = false

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"
name = "indra_trace_context"
edition = "2024"
required-features = []
crate-type = ["lib"]
